title: Staging recovery replay unqualified view dependency ordering

phases.objective: Preserve fail-closed role-aware Staging schema replay while ordering unqualified same-role view dependencies before dependent views without expanding grants or replay authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Docker Staging recovery operator
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A MariaDB dump view that references another same-role view through an unqualified backticked FROM or JOIN relation is emitted after its dependency, while cross-role views remain excluded and replay authority remains non-root and Staging-only.
steps: Parse qualified disposable-builder dependencies and unqualified backticked FROM or JOIN relations from the role schema dump.
Build the same-role dependency graph and topologically emit the parent view before a lexical child-before-parent dependent view.
Run the Staging database recovery contract fixture that mirrors v_activation_agent_skill_grants depending on v_effective_agent_skill_grants.
Verify cross-role exclusion, CURRENT_USER definer rebinding, no grant expansion, no root replay, and no Production or provider access.
assertions: v_effective_agent_skill_grants is ordered before v_activation_agent_skill_grants even though lexical order would place the child first.
Qualified disposable-builder dependency discovery remains supported.
Cross-role views remain excluded from isolated role replay and no cross-role grants are added.
Replay remains bound to CURRENT_USER and does not use root replay or SET USER authority.
The change performs no Production, Hostinger, Cloudflare, provider, migration Apply, database recovery rerun, or credential mutation.

phases.objective: This Staging-only replay ordering repair grants no Production deployment, provider mutation, credential access, or production_live authority.
blockers: Production remains outside this pull request and requires a separate governed promotion and operational evidence.
No Production, Hostinger, Cloudflare, provider, migration Apply, root replay, or recovery execution is authorized by this declaration.
